resources.string: Bluetooth connection
Use the car’s factory Bluetooth

Use system Bluetooth on Android phones. Select E01 or H52 only for a matching head unit, and pair in its factory phone app. After switching, choose your iPhone again below. Vehicle connectivity remains unverified.
Reading devices paired with the car…
The installed ECARX Bluetooth SDK could not be loaded. Keep this code for the test result.
The factory SDK has no usable SPP data interface. This firmware cannot run this experiment through that interface.
Factory Bluetooth is not ready, or its local address is unavailable. Open the factory phone app and turn on its Bluetooth.
No selected iPhone was found in the factory paired list. Pair in the factory phone app, then choose your iPhone again.
The factory data callback was refused, incompatible, or the phone already has a data session.
The factory data connection was refused or timed out. Unlock the paired iPhone and keep its Bluetooth on.
The factory data channel disconnected or could not transfer data. Keep this code for the test result.
The factory data channel opened, but the CarPlay handshake did not complete. A Bluetooth connection alone does not confirm compatibility.
The factory interface stopped responding. Close and reopen DiPlay before retrying.
Choose Bluetooth interface
System Bluetooth (default)
E01 car Bluetooth (ECARX)
H52 car Bluetooth (ANW)
Select H52 ANW to check its factory paired list. Missing or incompatible services fail explicitly. Connecting may initialize the local SPP service; it does not switch the factory radio on or off.
H52 ANW service is unavailable, unresponsive or incompatible. This does not mean factory Bluetooth is broken; try the ECARX backend.
Choose your iPhone from the H52 ANW factory paired list again.
H52 ANW did not establish a usable data connection. Keep factory Bluetooth on and record this error and the diagnostic report.
